source.evidence: Instrument owner's public documentation of three colocated photometers at home site in eastern Tucson, AZ, including SG-WAS SG_088 and TESS-W stars19. Device intercomparison reports SG_088 about 0.5 mag/arcsec^2 brighter than stars19 across most observed astronomical-darkness regime, with fitted slope 1.032 after accounting for zero-point offset. SG-WAS also measures sky-facing thermal IR and case temperature for a rough clear/cloudy screening.
source.source_section: The location; The photometers; Device intercomparison
source.correct_from_source: Do not interpret the owner's dark-night interinstrument fit as a validated twilight spectral calibration or an established persistent 0.5-mag offset in twilight.

observed_comparison.calibration_domain: mostly astronomically dark conditions at same eastern Tucson site; not 10.5-16deg twilight
observed_comparison.inference: Per-record mag_err reflects reported repeatability/noise only; it is not a bound on bandpass, absolute photometric zero point, clouds, or solar-only sky model error.
observed_comparison.sky_temperature_channel: SG-WAS and TESS instruments have skyward thermal IR measurements; contemporaneous channel should be acquired and quality-controlled before attributing between-night changes to aerosols.

frozen_same_instrument_native_comparison.fixed_device: SG_088 both nights June 17 and 18 UTC 2023
frozen_same_instrument_native_comparison.property: A hypothetical constant SG_088 magnitude zero-point offset cancels identically in same-instrument time-slot differences. Variable cloud/aerosol/skyglow/instrument drift remain unexcluded.

scientific_admission.site_identity: SG_088 east Tucson device owner confirmed at city-level; do not treat coordinates as measured precise.
scientific_admission.directional_sky_model_comparison: UNSUPPORTED: zenith 90 deg outside <=80-deg late-MYSTIC and spectral response mismatch.
scientific_admission.not_permitted: No correction of twilight data by the ~0.5mag deep-night intercept; no lunar-free = cloud-free inference; no model fit or release promotion.
scientific_admission.next_test: Acquire owner/portal exact SG_088 installation metadata and timestamped sky-vs-case IR channel on June 17/18 2023; add a separate co-timed raw stars19 comparison if independently obtainable; then assess instrument/atmosphere confounders without changing star-first-visibility model.
